verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party docs say it tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through issues, with assignments, milestones, due dates, dependencies, and time tracking. The product site adds that requirements, features, and bugs are managed through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards. Every element of the story is claimed, but only in brief summary-level statements. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of label and assignee management, independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue tracker.
